nodes.label: WeekCalendar Component
nodes.rationale: WeekCalendar owns all calendar state (currentWeekStart, occurrences, loading) as single source of truth to prevent synchronization bugs; pages become thin configuration wrappers. Self-contained component fetches own data via useEffect triggered on week changes.

nodes.label: FungibleResource DB Model
nodes.rationale: Groups interchangeable physical resources (e.g., all meeting rooms) so capacity checks and calendar queries can operate on the group level rather than individual resources, enabling a single query instead of N queries.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_recurring_reservations
nodes.rationale: Handles recurring reservation expansion in SQL using generate_series to produce individual occurrence rows, avoiding N+1 queries from application code for recurring series.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_reservations_for_calendar (single resource, OR logic)
nodes.rationale: Collapses multi-step application-level filtering (approved OR user's pending) + recurring expansion + exception handling into a single PostgreSQL function call, reducing 11+ round-trips to 1 and cutting code from 82 to 45 lines.
nodes.norm_label: postgresql function: expand_reservations_for_calendar (single resource, or logic)

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_reservations_for_calendar_by_fungible
nodes.rationale: Extends single-resource calendar function to operate on an entire FungibleResource group using IN subquery, reducing N individual resource queries to 1 group query. 80-90% faster for typical resource counts.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Function: expand_reservations_for_calendar_by_type
nodes.rationale: Final evolution: passes only the resource type string; PostgreSQL resolves all fungible groups and resources internally. API code reduces to ~5 lines per endpoint. Eliminates the application-side fungible resource lookup from the critical path.

nodes.label: ResourceType Enum (Deprecated)
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded MEETING/AUDITORIUM/COWORKING/LAB enum being removed from schema, SQL functions, and all application code. Replaced by Space model + FungibleResource FK to enable dynamic, DB-driven space configuration.

nodes.label: JWT Session Strategy
nodes.rationale: Adopted in Next.js middleware because edge runtime cannot access database; middleware uses getToken() from next-auth/jwt. Stateless verification without DB round-trip enables auth checks in Vercel edge network.

nodes.label: Database Session Strategy
nodes.rationale: Recommended over JWT for La Nube main app: supports instant role revocation, real-time permission changes, and full session audit. Coworking scale does not require JWT's horizontal scalability benefits.

nodes.label: EventsGrid Component (Paginated)
nodes.rationale: Replaces scroll-snap EventsCarousel with a responsive paginated grid (1/2/3/4 columns via Tailwind breakpoints). Page size adapts to column count on mount to minimize layout shift. Includes asterisk badge for events with exceptions.

nodes.label: expandAllEventOccurrences (TS function)
nodes.rationale: Variant of expandEventOccurrences that passes nowMs=0 to include past occurrences. Used on public event detail page to show full session agenda including historical sessions.

nodes.label: SpacesSection Landing Component (DB-driven)
nodes.rationale: Replaces static ServicesSection; fetches spaces from DB at SSR time via getPublicSpaces(). Featured space renders as full-width card; remaining spaces in 3-column grid. Returns null when no spaces exist.

Six or more people — men and women of various ages — are seated at rows of long white desks separated by low grey dividers, each working on a laptop. The furniture is modern: white frame ergonomic mesh chairs with tan seat cushions. Walls are exposed brick; tall glass windows fill the left side with bright natural daylight.
